problem: Step 5 says the predicted span 'team in Pune' 'misses the gold boundary and type target'. Its type is LOC, which is the same type as the gold entity Pune (LOC); only the start and end are wrong. A student may conclude the type was also wrong and that a type mismatch is what caused the error.
fix: 'team in Pune' has the right type (LOC) but the wrong boundaries: the gold span is Pune alone. Start, end and type must all match, so it is still a false positive, and Pune is a false negative.

problem: The worked example puts the title 'Mr' outside the person span (O), but Q4's answer puts 'Ms' inside the span as B-PER. The question does not say whether titles belong to the gold span, so a student who follows the worked-example convention (Ms/O Iyer/B-PER) would be marked wrong even though that answer is a legal BIO sequence.
fix: State the convention in the question, for example: 'Ms Iyer flew from Delhi to Wipro office in Bengaluru' — tag it twice, once with titles outside the person span and once with the title included — and note that both are legal BIO sequences; only the gold annotation decides which is correct.
